case_title: KANUBHAI BHAGVANBHAI NAYAK v. STATE OF GUJARAT
neutral_facts: The accused was present at the scene of the offence and carried out the attack on the victim, resulting in his death. The post mortem report indicated that the injuries on the victim's body revealed that the death was homicidal. The prosecution presented evidence from various witnesses and a medical report to establish the cause of death. The trial court convicted the accused under Section 302 of the Indian Penal Code. The High Court confirmed the conviction and sentence, but the Supreme Court found that the High Court did not properly examine the evidence or address the issues raised by the accused in the appeal.
